weakness: The email account, which is also the email suite administrator, has no MFA (turned off in 2024 for scan-to-email)
source: P07 assessment (IA-02(01)); P03 G-017; P01 R-001
remediation_plan: Switch the printer-scanner to scan-to-folder and delete its stored password; turn on MFA for the mailbox and block basic sign-in methods; unique passphrase in a password manager
milestones: 2026-09-15 scan-to-folder working, MFA on, sign-in test passed
resources_required: Owner time (2 hours) and IT consultant (1 hour, about $120); password manager about $40 a year

weakness: Practice management has no MFA and shares the email password; client portal MFA is optional
remediation_plan: Turn on practice management MFA with a unique passphrase; set client portal MFA to required and tell clients in the pre-season letter
milestones: 2026-09-15 practice management MFA on; 2027-01-15 portal MFA required

weakness: No account types, approvals, offboarding, monitoring, or reviews; 2025 contract preparer account left active (disabled 2026-07-29)
source: P07 assessment (AC-02 objectives); P03 G-012; P01 R-005
remediation_plan: POL-01 7.4: written approval and last-day removal for any helper; quarterly review of tax software users and accountant access; weekly EFIN and PTIN counts in filing season
milestones: 2026-10-01 first quarterly review; 2027-01-15 weekly counts start

weakness: Returns emailed as plain attachments; client documents received by text and kept in the camera roll and personal photo backup
source: P07 assessment (SC-08); P03 G-014, G-015; P01 R-004
remediation_plan: Portal-only exchange of returns and source documents (POL-01 8.4); move existing photos to client folders and delete them from the phone and photo backup; pre-season letter to clients
milestones: 2026-10-31 photo cleanup done; 2027-01-15 portal-only in effect
resources_required: Owner time; no added cost (portal already licensed)

weakness: Email and file suite has only 30 days of version history; laptop files and security documents not backed up
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09c.); P01 R-012
remediation_plan: Encrypted backup service for the suite with one-year retention; keep client files in the suite; test one restore
milestones: 2026-11-30 backup running and one file restored

weakness: No vendor list or safeguard requirements; AI assistant and practice management terms unreviewed; IT consultant's remote-support MFA unconfirmed
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-016, G-028, G-029; P01 R-008
remediation_plan: Vendor list (POL-01 6.2); pre-adoption checklist (6.3); review practice management terms; confirm the consultant's MFA; annual SOC 2 review
milestones: 2026-09-30 consultant MFA confirmed; 2026-10-31 vendor list and terms review done

weakness: Mailbox sign-ins and rules and the tax software activity log never reviewed
remediation_plan: Monthly review on the first business day and every Monday in filing season using a one-page checklist; weekly for 3 months after any incident or phishing attempt

weakness: No incident reporting times or notification contact list; IRS next-business-day rule unknown
source: P07 assessment (IR-06 objectives); P03 G-034, G-043, G-049; P01 R-013
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and matrix (done 2026-08-31); print contacts and record the IRS Stakeholder Liaison number; walkthrough with the IT consultant

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
source: P07 assessment (RA-03d. and RA-03f.); P03 G-011
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 and 4.7 set an annual July review, change triggers, and the consumer count check

weakness: Client tax return information put into a general-purpose AI assistant with no IRC 7216 basis
remediation_plan: No client data in the tool (done 2026-07-27); counsel reviews the past uploads and any future consent route; POL-01 9.5 in force
milestones: 2026-10-31 counsel's written advice received and recorded in P10
resources_required: Counsel (about 2 hours, through the carrier's panel rates if available)

weakness: No security training and no call-back rule for refund bank, address, or email changes
remediation_plan: POL-01 8.5 call-back rule in force; security course with social engineering and business email compromise modules; pre-season client letter that the firm never accepts bank changes by email

weakness: Single-person dependency: no continuation agreement, no stored recovery codes, one authenticator
remediation_plan: Sealed recovery codes and access sheet with the owner's attorney; continuation agreement with another CPA after counsel's IRC 7216 advice; second authenticator if the vendor allows

weakness: No retention schedule; files back to 2014 and paper back to 2019; IRS authorizations for about 40 former clients still on file
remediation_plan: Written retention schedule (Forms 8879 at least 3 years); withdraw old authorizations; first purge after the 2027 filing season with a disposal record
milestones: 2026-12-31 schedule adopted and authorizations withdrawn; 2027-06-30 first purge
resources_required: Owner time; shredding service for old paper (about $100)
